content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge marks the clash UNDERDETERMINED, so K-S2's limit on grounds for that label is in play.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb; answered in [CR3] LINK 2.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
